title: Introduce new joypad features provided by SDL3
body:
**DO NOT PANIC! The features in this PR are not being abandoned, this PR has been split into multiple smaller PRs so the features can be more easily reviewed and merged, see the end of this post for more details.**

Closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/2829
Closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/8519
Closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/6930
Closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/3799
Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/78805
Potentially addresses https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/98008
Partially addresses https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/12087

Supersedes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/88590
Supersedes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/89193

Since SDL joypad driver was merged recently ( https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/106218 ), this PR adds support for new SDL joypad features that weren't previously possible due to older custom joypad implementations. These features include:
- Getting access to gamepad's sensors (accelerometer and gyroscope), including sensor calibration and simulated gravity sensor (because SDL doesn't support real gravity sensors);
- Setting gamepad's LED light, if supported by the gamepad;
- Getting information about controller's power and connection information;
- Getting access to gamepad's touchpad(s);
- DualSense adaptive triggers;
- Xbox rumble triggers (only available on Xbox One controllers, not to be confused with DualSense adaptive triggers).
- Getting gamepad's model type to check if it's a PS4 controller, an Xbox One controller, etc.;
- Getting joypad type (checking if it's a gamepad, arcade stick, flight stick, etc.);
- Getting the number of available buttons and axes on a controller;
- Getting the names for gamepad's button and axes names, if available (these may not work exactly as expected if the gamepad is not a first-party gamepad from PlayStation, Xbox or Nintendo because SDL cannot otherwise check what the labels on the controller are);
- Sending custom data packets to supported controllers via `Input.send_joy_packet()`.

There are other more complex features that can be done with SDL functionality, but I decided to move them to separate PRs (see "TODO for separate PRs" section below).

There are some SDL functions that may not be necessary in Godot, so I think they need some discussion before they can be implemented (see "Features that need to be discussed whether they should be implemented or not" section below).

<details>
<summary>Roadmap and TODO</summary>

- [x] Accelerometer/gyroscope enabling and getting
- [x] [SDL_GamepadHasSensor](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/SDL_GamepadHasSensor)
- [x] [SDL_SetGamepadLED](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/SDL_SetGamepadLED)
- [x] [SDL_GetGamepadStringForAxis](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/SDL_GetGamepadStringForAxis) and [SDL_GetGamepadStringForButton](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/SDL_GetGamepadStringForButton)
- [x] `Input.get_joy_model()` (because JoyType enum already exists) and `Input.get_joy_scheme()` (see [SDL_GetGamepadType](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/SDL_GetGamepadType))
- [x] [SDL_GetGamepadPowerInfo](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/SDL_GetGamepadPowerInfo)
- [x] [SDL_GetGamepadSensorDataRate](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/SDL_GetGamepadSensorDataRate)
- [x] [SDL_GetGamepadConnectionState](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/SDL_GetGamepadConnectionState)
- [x] [SDL_JoystickType](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/SDL_JoystickType)
- [x] [SDL_GetNumJoystickButtons](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/SDL_GetNumJoystickButtons), [SDL_GetNumJoystickAxes](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/SDL_GetNumJoystickAxes)
- [x] ~~[SDL_GetJoystickVendor](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/SDL_GetJoystickVendor), [SDL_GetJoystickProduct](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/SDL_GetJoystickProduct) for `Input.get_joy_info()` (see https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/98861 )~~ Moved to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/108214
- [x] Touchpad functions
- [x] Dualsense adaptive triggers (see https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/issues/5125 and https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/issues/4859#issuecomment-951532706 )
- - https://github.com/ValveSoftware/Proton/blob/ea07c02886cd1b1527761fb2222538fb9a92af33/lsteamclient/steamworks_sdk_157/isteamdualsense.h
- - I can't test it myself, because I don't have a Dualsense
- [x] Xbox rumble triggers support
- [x] Make sure Joycons work properly, including accelerometer and gyroscope
- [x] Separate JoyScheme entry for horizontal joycons and fix the names for face buttons
- [x] Accelerometer/gyroscope calibration methods (`Input.start_joy_motion_calibration()`, `Input.step_joy_motion_calibration()`, `Input.stop_joy_motion_calibration()`, `Input.clear_joy_motion_calibration()`)
- [x] ~~[SDL_SetJoystickPlayerIndex](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/SDL_SetJoystickPlayerIndex) to set the physical joypad's player indication (LED light count for Switch and Wii controllers, LED color for PlayStation, no action for other controllers)~~ Didn't work for my joycon controllers and my Dualshock 4, even though the method returned true
- [x] Make all of the code thread safe, if it's not already (see bruvzg's PR)
- [x] `Input.get/set_joy_motion_calibration()` to save/load calibration settings, uses Dictionary to do that
- [x] Warn the user on Input.stop_joy_motion_calibration() if there are no/not enough calibration steps
- [x] `Input.get_joy_model_axis/button_name()`
- [x] Use is_ prefix instead of get_ for methods returning bool
- [x] Use Color.srgb_to_linear() for set_joy_light()
- [x] `Input.get_joy_gravity()` (see https://developer.android.com/reference/android/hardware/SensorEvent#values )
- [x] Fix adaptive triggers (see https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/blob/f201b64ffe1380713b181a3421c7fd910c95aada/test/testgamecontroller.c#L304-L352 )
- [x] `Input.get_joy_touchpad_pressure()`
- [x] Handle `SDL_ENABLED` being not defined
- [x] Linux support
- [x] macOS support
- [x] Add new files to the SDL update script
- [x] Calibration: axes deadzone, not just vector length deadzone
- [x] Add `get_joy_scheme()` override feature, and reflect that in `get_joy_model_axis/button_name()` (note for myself: I have an 8BitDo Wireless Adapter that can work in PlayStation Classic Controller mode, so at least an override for this one should exist so it actually reports as having PlayStation scheme)
- [x] Accelerometer object's Y velocity is reversed in the test project (when the controller is moved upwards, the object should also move upwards)
- [x] Gravity (in the engine code) is reversed on all 3 axes
- ~~DualSense advanced haptic feedback? https://controllers.fandom.com/wiki/Sony_DualSense Output report https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/12087~~ DualSense advanced haptic feedback is audio-based, I assume DualSense is exposing this features as an audio device on Windows (Sources: https://www.pcgamingwiki.com/wiki/Controller:DualSense#:~:text=audio%2Dbased%20haptic%20feedback%20are%20natively%20supported%20(see%20support%20in%20games)%2C%20though%20the%20latter%20is%20only%20supported%20with%20a%20wired%20connection and https://www.reddit.com/r/PS5/comments/jnp8tu/heres_how_to_get_audio_haptic_feedback_with/ ), so I assume it's already possible to use in Godot (see https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_audioserver.html#class-audioserver-property-output-device ), but to make it work better multiple output devices are required, so this feature essentially depends on https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/11288
- [x] `Input.send_joy_packet()` [SDL_SendJoystickEffect](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/SDL_SendJoystickEffect)
- [x] Fix motion sensors not working after hotplugging (It only affected the test project because after hotplugging the motion sensors weren't being enabled)
- [x] Fix motion sensors not working properly after recalibrating (Seems to be already been fixed somehow)
- [x] DualSense Misc1 and PaddleX button names
- [x] Update the example project below
- [x] Fix Meorge's macOS issue (Done by bruvzg, thank you!)

Documentation:
- [x] Documentation for joypad device types (`SDL_JoystickType`): https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/xinput/xinput-and-controller-subtypes
- [x] Sensor documentation: https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/SDL_SensorType ~~(BTW Horizontal joycons' yaw and roll axes are swapped, needs to be reported to SDL github)~~ Just checked again, they're not
- [x] How accelerometer's gravity is calculated: https://developer.android.com/reference/android/hardware/SensorEvent#values
- [x] Document how to get raw accelerometer values (`Input.get_joy_accelerometer() + Input.get_joy_gravity()`)
- [x] `Input.get_joy_model_axis/button_name()` may not work exactly as expected if the gamepad is not a first-party gamepad from PlayStation, Xbox or Nintendo because SDL cannot otherwise check what the labels on the controller are
- [x] Motion sensors examples with calibration
- [x] SDL doesn't support motion sensors (and LED light) on platforms other than the desktop ones (they don't work well on Android and iOS and they don't work at all on Web since no hidapi support on Web)
- [x] Fix "TODO: description"
</details>

<details>
<summary>TODO when Godot gets SDL input support for other platforms</summary>

- [ ] Check which functions work on Android
- [ ] Check which functions work on iOS
- [ ] Check which functions work on Web
- [ ] Web: trigger rumble support for SDL ( https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/GamepadHapticActuator/effects#trigger-rumble )
</details>

<details>
<summary>TODO for separate PRs</summary>

- [x] SDL Haptic system ( https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/8309 https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/CategoryHaptic ) ( https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/114642 )
- [ ] Replace InputEvent classes boilerplate code with something more simple
- [ ] Rework Godot's hat functionality (at the moment it only supports 1 hat) (also see https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/83322 and https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/65330 ),  [SDL_GetNumJoystickHats](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/SDL_GetNumJoystickHats)
- [ ] `Input.get_pov_hat_vector()` (see https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/9850 )
- [ ] [SDL_GetJoystickBall](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/SDL_GetJoystickBall), [SDL_GetNumJoystickBalls](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/SDL_GetNumJoystickBalls)
- [ ] Hat (see https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/9850 ) and ball events
- [ ] Add new hat and ball functionality to InputMap
- [ ] Proper Joycon support?
- [ ] Fix potential memory leak in Input.get_joy_name()
- [ ] Touchpad events
- [ ] ~~Battery/power events~~ That's not something the player can control, so no need to add these events
- [ ] Godot events for accelerometer/gyroscope (`InputEventJoypadAccelerometer`, `InputEventJoypadGyroscope`)
- [ ] Virtual joypad support (see https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/7071 ), [SDL_AttachVirtualJoystick](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/SDL_AttachVirtualJoystick) [SDL_SetJoystickVirtualButton](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/SDL_SetJoystickVirtualButton) etc.
- [ ] Expose SDL's HIDAPI capabilities? https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/CategoryHIDAPI https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/12089
- [ ] Tray support for all platforms? https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/CategoryTray
</details>

<details>
<summary>Features that need to be discussed whether they should be implemented or not</summary>

- [SDL_GetJoystickSerial](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/SDL_GetJoystickSerial)
- [SDL_GetJoystickFirmwareVersion](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/SDL_GetJoystickFirmwareVersion)
- [SDL_GetGamepadPath](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/SDL_GetGamepadPath)
- ~~[SDL_GetGamepadSteamHandle](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/SDL_GetGamepadSteamHandle) (for https://godotsteam.com/classes/input/ ?)~~ Handled by https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/108214
</details>

TODO 2:
- [ ] Test project on macOS doesn't recognize the joycon controllers, even though InputMap does recognize them
- [ ] Mention that people will need some sort of driver for Xbox trigger rumble to work, there's an SDL github issue where that's described (or maybe they won't need it? https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/issues/12071 )
- [ ] Mention that it's recommended to disable the motion sensors if they're no longer needed because it can theoretically drain the controller's battery more quickly
- [ ] `Input.get_joy_accelerometer()` should probably return the raw accelerometer values, while there should be another method `Input.get_joy_accelerometer_motion()` that's equivalent to the current functionality, I think?
- [ ] Don't rely on SDL's enums directly, we may need a function to convert SDL's enums to Godot enums (for example, so we can have `PLAYSTATION_GENERIC` joypad model or Steam Deck model)
- [ ] Fix rumble triggers

- [x] Xbox rumble triggers (only available on Xbox One controllers, not to be confused with DualSense adaptive triggers). ( https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/116214 )
- [x] Getting gamepad's model type to check if it's a PS4 controller, an Xbox One controller, etc.; ( https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/112680 )
- [x] Getting joypad type (checking if it's a gamepad, arcade stick, flight stick, etc.); ( https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/112680 )
- Getting the number of available buttons and axes on a controller; (needs discussion)
- [x] Getting the names for gamepad's button and axes names, if available ( https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/112680 )
- [x] Sending custom data packets to supported controllers via `Input.send_joy_packet()`. ( https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/111682 )

Here's a small project to test new joypad features: 
[JoypadTest.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21773533/JoypadTest.zip)
